title: Why Airports Make You Walk Farther
topic: Why airports make you walk farther
mechanism: Idle waiting feels longer than busy time, so the airport hid the bag wait in a longer walk and complaints vanished.

beats.hook: You land in Houston and the hallway just keeps going
beats.story: You reach baggage claim just as your suitcase rolls out
beats.rise: Perfect timing: the luckiest traveler alive
beats.twist: A staff door opens: a manager drags your gate to the far end of the airport map
beats.mechanism: Complaint box overflowing, handler counter, stopwatch screens WALK 1 MIN / WAIT 7 MIN, map with the gate dragged away, gauge WALK x6, complaint counter falling to 0, 1985 rule board BUSY TIME FEELS SHORTER, hotel elevator mirrors
beats.ending: Next trip the farthest gate again, smiling the whole way

seed.what: The STAFF ONLY door in the long hallway

locations.set: Room daylight + long corridor + gate signs + staff door
Room cold + airport map board + manager
Room neon re-light of baggage claim with crowd

gags.what: The complaint box overflows and letters burst out over the clerk
A bored passenger at the belt gets bonked by a suitcase sliding off the carousel
A hotel guest fixes her hair in the mirror so long the elevator doors close on her
